---
title: "Diet indices vs beta diversity: summary across distances"
author: "Giacomo Antonello"
format: html
params:
  outdir: "results/beta_diversity"
  n_permutations: 999
  n_permutations_covariates: 999
---

Combines the per-distance results of `04-diet-vs-beta.qmd` (one render per
distance) and computes the Benjamini-Hochberg FDR across all distances and diet
indices, separately for the PERMANOVA and betadisper tests. Run it after all
distances have finished; distances not yet run are reported and left out.

The permutation parameters select which run of `04-diet-vs-beta.qmd` to
summarize: set them to the values used there (e.g. `-P n_permutations:9999`
for a sensitivity analysis).

```{r setup, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(openxlsx2)
```

```{r read results}
distances <- c("Bray-Curtis", "Canberra", "unweighted_UniFrac", "weighted_UniFrac")

run_label <- sprintf("perm%d_covperm%d", params$n_permutations, params$n_permutations_covariates)
run_outdir <- file.path(params$outdir, run_label)
distance_dirs <- file.path(run_outdir, distances)
done <- file.exists(file.path(distance_dirs, "PERMANOVA.xlsx"))
stopifnot("No results for these permutation parameters" = any(done))
if (any(!done)) {
  warning("Distances without results, left out of the summary: ", paste(distances[!done], collapse = ", "))
}

read_all <- function(file, sheet) {
  map(distance_dirs[done], \(d) read_xlsx(file.path(d, file), sheet = sheet)) %>% bind_rows()
}

permanova_results.df <- read_all("PERMANOVA.xlsx", "diet_indices")
betadisper_results.df <- read_all("betadisper.xlsx", "test")
dbrda_results.df <- read_all("dbRDA.xlsx", "inertia")

# covariate rows only, with the FDR within each distance computed in 04-diet-vs-beta.qmd
covariates_results.df <- map(distance_dirs[done], function(d) {
  read_xlsx(file.path(d, "PERMANOVA.xlsx"), sheet = "covariates") %>%
    filter(!term %in% c("Residual", "Total")) %>%
    transmute(distance = str_replace(basename(d), "_", " "), term, Df, R2, F, p.value = `Pr(>F)`) %>%
    mutate(p.adj = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH"))
}) %>%
  bind_rows()
```

# Diet indices

FDR across all distances and diet indices.

```{r fdr}
permanova_results.df <- permanova_results.df %>%
  mutate(p.adj = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH"))
betadisper_results.df <- betadisper_results.df %>%
  mutate(p.adj = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH"))

knitr::kable(permanova_results.df, digits = 4, caption = "PERMANOVA, diet index adjusted for covariates")
knitr::kable(betadisper_results.df, digits = 4, caption = "Betadisper, quartiles of the diet index")
knitr::kable(dbrda_results.df, digits = 4, caption = "dbRDA inertia")
```

# Covariates

```{r covariates}
knitr::kable(covariates_results.df, digits = 4, caption = "Marginal PERMANOVA of each covariate, FDR within distance")
```

# Write results

```{r write results}
write_xlsx(
  list(
    PERMANOVA = permanova_results.df,
    PERMANOVA_covariates = covariates_results.df,
    betadisper = betadisper_results.df,
    dbRDA = dbrda_results.df
  ),
  file = file.path(run_outdir, sprintf("beta_vs_diet_summary_%s.xlsx", run_label))
)
```
